name: Lingshan Island & Zhucha Island (灵山岛、竹岔岛)
verdict: Island-tourism destinations of Qingdao's West Coast New Area shown on the back of Qingdao West Coast's 2026 CSL home shirt. No sponsoring entity was named in the available sources; ownership not verified.
note: Back-of-shirt advertising on Qingdao West Coast's 2026 CSL home shirt carries the words '灵山岛、竹岔岛' (Lingshan Island, Zhucha Island), two islands off the coast of the West Coast New Area presented in the club's launch coverage as cultural-tourism landmarks of the district (kit record qingdao-west-coast-2026-27-home). Neither the club's launch coverage nor later reporting names a sponsoring company or public body behind the back-of-shirt advertisement, so no ownership claim could be written and the sponsor stays 'not rated yet'.
